title: Free Phonics Worksheets — Letter Sounds, CVC Words, Beginning/Initial Sounds

overview.description: Phonics worksheets covering letter sounds, CVC (consonant-vowel-consonant) words, and beginning/initial sounds. CVC words (cat, dog, sun, etc.) are the first real words children decode — the bridge from individual letter sounds to reading. From the filename this likely includes: letter-sound matching, CVC word building/reading, and initial sound identification. Third phonics/beginning sounds drop from Aless.

notes: Link likely expired. Third phonics drop. CVC words are the critical bridge between phonological awareness (sounds) and actual reading (decoding words). Aless ELA progression is now: letter ID → beginning sounds → CVC words → rhyming → compound words → phoneme substitution. The full decoding pipeline.
